items.title: Butch Miles interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 9, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I mean I recorded with Basie, recorded with Mulligan, recorded with Alberta Hunter. Here’s a name for you, Dolly Dawn, there’s one, remember that one.

ctx.x: Because I have a candidate by the way.

I would have to say that if I did include one of mine, which, now that you bring it up, offhand I wouldn’t, but if I did out of all the albums, I’ve done over a hundred, a hundred © Fillius Jazz Archive -9-

and some albums with everybody. I mean I recorded with Basie, recorded with Mulligan, recorded with Alberta Hunter. Here’s a name for you, Dolly Dawn, there’s one, remember that one. And a lot of different people. There’d be a Basie recording which is called “Live in Japan.” And we recorded that one, not the last one that was recorded about 2007 I think or 2006, but way before when it was recorded back in 1978. The band was smoking hot and I just had all of my you-know-what together. And we were a unit. It was…
